## About

An informal channel for discussing literature and exchanging ideas in (applied and Bayesian) statistical methodology. Open to all graduate students, postdocs, and faculty.:::

::: {.home-section}
## Format

Details about the meeting format will be posted here when available.
:::

::: {.home-section}
## Schedule and readings

Weekly meeting every Friday from 4 p.m. to 5 p.m. The [schedule](schedule.qmd) and [reading materials](readings.qmd) will be updated as the group progresses.
